name: Oak Lord
body:
You grow larger than your brethren.

Prerequisites: Plant Type, 7 HD, Photosynthetic Healing

Benefit: You must spend an entire week “rooted” as a tree. Over the duration of that time you are able to increase your size to Large, incurring all bonuses and penalties as normal.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
